name: Microsoft Execution Containers (MXC)
description: Runs untrusted model output, plugins, and tools in policy-driven sandboxes on Windows, Linux, and macOS through Rust, .NET, and Node SDKs, for apps that execute agent code.

skills.name: Policy-Driven Sandboxing
skills.description: Applies JSON filesystem, network, and UI policies to each contained workload.

skills.name: Multiple Containment Backends
skills.description: Selects a platform backend such as ProcessContainer, Bubblewrap, Seatbelt, LXC, or MicroVM behind one model.

skills.name: Container Lifecycle
skills.description: Provisions, starts, executes in, stops, and deprovisions persistent containers through versioned SDK APIs.

skills.name: Diagnostics and Audit Mode
skills.description: Explains access-denied failures and records observed accesses to help author ProcessContainer policies.
